clips.title: The story
paras: Deep beneath Stonetalon Peak, the Barrow Key lies locked in the Talon Den. It is one of three druidic keys guarding the ancient treasures sealed within the den's hoard.

Night elf druids placed wards throughout the Talon Den's underground barrows to protect their relics from intruders. The Barrow Key is hidden in a cache among the passages, one part of that layered defense. The cache opens only with the Gatekeeper's Key, so a seeker must know the druids' defenses to reach it.
